title: Add RAG templates, agent tool-calling examples, and docs quickstarts
author: Ava Martinez
description: Adds a set of RAG template prompts, three agent/tool-calling quickstart examples (Python, TypeScript, and a minimal Go example), and updates to the docs site navigation and quickstart landing page. Motivation: provide reproducible, production-oriented examples for developers evaluating Redwood for retrieval-augmented workflows and agent patterns. Changes include RAG prompt templates with metadata, agent wrappers demonstrating tool-calling for search and database lookups, a new docs quickstart that links to runnable examples and a playground, docs site sidebar updates, and CI docs-build tests. Includes a short migration note for existing example consumers. Checklist: 1) Add RAG templates and prompt guidance 2) Add agent tool-calling examples for Python/TS/Go 3) Update docs site quickstarts and sidebar 4) Add unit tests and docs-build CI 5) Update changelog and release notes.
